## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important defect needs fixing: AGENTS.md still says to run `make test`, but this pull request removes that target, so an agent that follows the guide runs a command that no longer exists.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

This also contradicts the new line at AGENTS.md:15: "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets." — Agents that follow the guide hit a make error instead of running the tests, and AGENTS.md:26 says these commands are the only checks a change gets. — Fix: In `AGENTS.md:24`, change `make test` to `make check`.
